exercises.title: Close the LAB_INFO table with Record
concepts: type-level mutation: wrong calls must be refused
exercises.problemHtml:
src/labs.ts types the lab table as an open dictionary, so a ghost lab is accepted and every read needs a fallback (?? 0 — a lab that does not exist “has 0 seats”). Change LabTable so the key set is exactly LabCode, and remove the fallback, so that kiem/dung.ts compiles (it reads LAB_INFO[code].capacity with no check), the wrong uses in kiem/sai.ts are refused, and the test passes.

Done when: tsc is clean on src/, kiem/dung.ts and the test; each marked line of kiem/sai.ts gets its code; node --test is green.

Requirements

  • Edit src/labs.ts. The other files (tests, kiem/…, helpers) belong to the grader: it always uses the original copy.
  • tsc with the course tsconfig (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, nodenext) reports 0 errors on your files + kiem/dung.ts, test/labs.test.ts.
  • Each line of kiem/sai.ts that ends in // expect TSxxxx is refused with exactly that code (TS7053, TS2741, TS7053); its other lines still compile.
  • node --test test/labs.test.ts exits with code 0 — Node 22 runs the .ts files by stripping the types.
  • No forbidden shortcut in your files: \bany\b, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, \?\?.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
src/labs.ts gõ kiểu bảng phòng là một từ điển mở, nên phòng ma vẫn được nhận và phép đọc nào cũng cần giá trị dự phòng (?? 0 — phòng không tồn tại “có 0 chỗ”). Đổi LabTable để tập khoá đúng là LabCode, và bỏ giá trị dự phòng, để kiem/dung.ts biên dịch được (nó đọc LAB_INFO[code].capacity không kiểm), các cách dùng sai trong kiem/sai.ts bị từ chối, và test qua.

Đạt khi: tsc sạch trên src/, kiem/dung.ts và test; mỗi dòng đánh dấu của kiem/sai.ts có đúng mã; node --test xanh.

Yêu cầu

  • Sửa src/labs.ts. Các tệp còn lại (test, kiem/…, tệp phụ) là của máy chấm: nó luôn dùng bản gốc.
  • tsc với tsconfig của khoá (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, nodenext) báo 0 lỗi trên tệp của bạn + kiem/dung.ts, test/labs.test.ts.
  • Mỗi dòng của kiem/sai.ts kết thúc bằng // expect TSxxxx bị từ chối với đúng mã đó (TS7053, TS2741, TS7053); các dòng khác vẫn biên dịch.
  • node --test test/labs.test.ts thoát với mã 0 — Node 22 chạy tệp .ts bằng cách bỏ kiểu.
  • Không dùng lối tắt bị cấm trong tệp của bạn: \bany\b, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, \?\?.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
The reference solution is in the Solution tab, with comments on every type it adds. It passes because the grader checks the same three things as the course's own checker (scripts/ts/kiem-de-ts.mjs): the files compile under the strict course tsconfig, every wrong call in the grader's files is refused with the expected error code, and the program still behaves the same when Node strips the types and runs it.

The usual wrong answers — Record<string, Lab> — the same open dictionary, spelled shorter; Record<LabCode, Lab>, but the ?? 0 fallback kept — each fail at least one of those checks: see "Common mistakes".

exercises.problemHtml:
seatsByLab in src/count.ts returns an open dictionary that starts empty: a lab with no booking is simply missing, and the dashboard shows NaN for it. Give it the return type Record<LabCode, number> and fix the body so that kiem/dung.ts compiles (it reads result['BE-202'] as a number), the wrong uses in kiem/sai.ts are refused, and the tests pass. No any, no casts.

Done when: tsc is clean on src/, kiem/dung.ts and the test; each marked line of kiem/sai.ts gets its code; node --test is green.

Requirements

  • Edit src/count.ts. The other files (tests, kiem/…, helpers) belong to the grader: it always uses the original copy.
  • tsc with the course tsconfig (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, nodenext) reports 0 errors on your files + kiem/dung.ts, test/count.test.ts.
  • Each line of kiem/sai.ts that ends in // expect TSxxxx is refused with exactly that code (TS7053, TS2322); its other lines still compile.
  • node --test test/count.test.ts exits with code 0 — Node 22 runs the .ts files by stripping the types.
  • No forbidden shortcut in your files: \bany\b, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, \bas\s+(?!const\b)\w+.

exercises.title: A user index that admits a miss
concepts: type-level mutation: wrong calls must be refused
exercises.problemHtml:
In src/users.ts, findUser promises it always returns a User — with a cast. A booking whose user was deleted crashes nameOf (“Cannot read properties of undefined”). Remove the cast, make the return type honest, and make nameOf return '(deleted user)' for a missing id, so that kiem/dung.ts compiles, the wrong use in kiem/sai.ts is refused, and the tests pass. No as, no !.

Done when: tsc is clean on src/, kiem/dung.ts and the test; the marked line of kiem/sai.ts gets its code; node --test is green.

Requirements

  • Edit src/users.ts. The other files (tests, kiem/…, helpers) belong to the grader: it always uses the original copy.
  • tsc with the course tsconfig (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, nodenext) reports 0 errors on your files + kiem/dung.ts, test/users.test.ts.
  • Each line of kiem/sai.ts that ends in // expect TSxxxx is refused with exactly that code (TS2532); its other lines still compile.
  • node --test test/users.test.ts exits with code 0 — Node 22 runs the .ts files by stripping the types.
  • No forbidden shortcut in your files: \bany\b, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, @ts-expect-error, \bas\s+(?!const\b)\w+, [\w$)\]]!(?=[.\[;,)\s]).

Bỏ phép ép, cho kiểu trả về trung thực, và cho nameOf trả '(deleted user)' khi id không có, để kiem/dung.ts biên dịch được, cách dùng sai trong kiem/sai.ts bị từ chối, và test qua. exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
The reference solution is in the Solution tab, with comments on every type it adds. It passes because the grader checks the same three things as the course's own checker (scripts/ts/kiem-de-ts.mjs): the files compile under the strict course tsconfig, every wrong call in the grader's files is refused with the expected error code, and the program still behaves the same when Node strips the types and runs it.

The usual wrong answers — cast swapped for a non-null assertion: byId[id]!; return type honest, nameOf still crashes on a missing id — each fail at least one of those checks: see "Common mistakes".
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi:
Lời giải tham khảo ở tab Lời giải, có chú thích cho từng kiểu thêm vào. Nó đạt vì máy chấm kiểm đúng ba điều như máy chấm của khoá (scripts/ts/kiem-de-ts.mjs): các tệp biên dịch sạch với tsconfig strict của khoá, mọi lời gọi sai trong tệp của máy chấm bị từ chối với đúng mã lỗi, và chương trình vẫn chạy y như cũ khi Node bỏ kiểu rồi chạy.

Các bài làm sai hay gặp — cast swapped for a non-null assertion: byId[id]!; return type honest, nameOf still crashes on a missing id — đều trượt ít nhất một kiểm: xem "Lỗi hay gặp".
